_meta.strategy: rename/remap the 8 existing Builder Variables in place, then mint the missing ones. Never delete an existing record — the home page alone holds 50 var(--uuid) references that resolve through them.

decisions.accent: accent-only orange — a state, not a surface: hover/focus/active, CTA buttons, pills, tag pills, 4px card left border. Never band backgrounds, headings or body text.
decisions.dark_mode: dark token VALUES are minted so a retrofit is cheap, but no component implements dark. No prefers-color-scheme branches, no toggle.

_meta.blocking_verification: RESOLVED 2026-07-31 against builder_variable.json. Builder Variable fields are: is_standard (Check), variable_name (Data), group (Data), type (Select), value (Data), dark_value (Data, shown when type=Color). The `type` Select accepts exactly TWO options: **Color** and **Dimension**.
verification_consequences: Dimension tokens ARE storable — spacing, radius, measures, band/header padding, and font SIZES all become type=Dimension records.

NOT storable as Builder Variables: font families, font weights, unitless line-heights, shadows, and motion/easing. There is no type for them. These ship as component props plus ONE injected head_html stylesheet.
dark_value lives on the SAME record as its light value. Separate dark-* records are wrong — an earlier draft of this manifest had five of them. Removed.
_meta.existing_group: cascadesteam — all 8 current records use this; keep it.

rename_in_place.why: It is the brand cyan and the dark-mode primary — NOT the light-mode primary. Named `primary` it invites use in light-mode blocks, which renders cyan where the brand wants navy.
Deepest brand navy from the logo SVG. `secondary` says nothing about what it is.
THE important one. This is the heading/link colour, not body text. Body copy (#4e4e4e) had no token at all, so body text is currently hardcoded or simply wrong.
Not in the source palette (#d4d4d4 is actually the dark-mode text value). Keep the record and repurpose it explicitly as the neutral hairline rather than leaving a stray.

_dark_mode_note: dark_value lives on the SAME record (Builder Variable has a dark_value Data field shown when type=Color). Values are minted; NO component implements dark mode.

not_storable_as_variables._note: No Builder Variable type covers these — Select accepts only Color and Dimension. Ship as component props plus ONE injected head_html stylesheet, and keep the values here as the single source.

font_family.heading: Rubik
font_family.stack_suffix: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

breakpoints._note: Builder hardcodes these; they are not authorable. The live site uses only 576, so 577-1024px currently gets the desktop layout with no tablet treatment.

apply_rules: Always emit var(--<uuid>, <literal-hex>) — the hex fallback means a token miss degrades to the right colour instead of to nothing.
Builder Variable IGNORES a client-supplied name and mints its own UUID on insert. Create, read the UUID back, THEN write var(--uuid) into blocks.
Renaming is safe: blocks reference the UUID, not the name. The 50+ existing references keep resolving.
After minting, sweep every page for hardcoded hex values and repoint them at tokens.
Do not delete any of the 8 existing records.
